WITH time_filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    gbsize,
    spanmin
  FROM scans
  WHERE chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin > 0
),
scan_with_site AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    si.healtheval,
    CAST(s.gbsize AS REAL) / CAST(s.spanmin AS REAL) AS ratio
  FROM time_filtered_scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    healtheval,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scan_with_site
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
mean_of_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg
  FROM group_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    g.zoneref,
    g.healtheval,
    g.avg_ratio,
    g.scan_count,
    g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS exceeds_mean
  FROM group_stats g
  CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages m
  WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  healtheval,
  avg_ratio,
  scan_count,
  exceeds_mean
FROM filtered_groups
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN exceeds_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  exceeds_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
